tagline: We make a number for every game. We bet the ones where the market's wrong.

games.our_fair: Crimson Tide 86.4% / Commodores 13.6% (devigged Pinnacle fair, moneyline)
games.take: No. 3 Alabama (7-2) rolls into Nashville after a 31-13 win at LSU, and Vanderbilt (4-5) just picked up its first SEC win, 25-23 at Mississippi State. Our fair number makes Alabama an 86.4% favorite, and no price clears our 0.75% bar — the least-bad number in the game is actually Alabama on the moneyline at -625 (+0.2% EV), which is still below the bar. No true edge, but the lean is Alabama -14: the better team by a wide margin, with the playoff stakes on their side and Vanderbilt's defense allowing 29.4 points a game.
games.title: Alabama at Vanderbilt: the morning showcase
games.verdict: LEAN: ALA -14.0 — no true edge; the least-bad price is the favorite's moneyline, so take the points with the better team.
games.weather: Cold morning across the region; no NWS watch or warning.

games.take: The closest number on the board: No. 8 Tennessee (7-2) is a one-point road favorite at Texas A&M (4-5) in a 43.5-total game — the market expects a low-scoring grind at Kyle Field. Our fair number is a coin flip, 51.2/48.8, and no price clears our 0.75% bar; the least-bad number is Tennessee on the moneyline at -108 (-1.4% EV). No true edge, but the lean is Tennessee -1: the better team with the playoff résumé on the line, laying a single point.
games.title: Tennessee at Texas A&M: the coin-flip SEC test
games.verdict: LEAN: TENN -1.0 — no true edge; a coin flip on our fair number, so take the better team laying one point.

games.take: No. 9 Indiana (8-1) hosts No. 18 USC (7-2) in the Big Ten game of the day, and the Hoosiers are laying 9 at home. Our fair number makes Indiana a 75% favorite, but no price clears our 0.75% bar — the least-bad number is Indiana on the moneyline at -330 (-2.2% EV), which tells you the favorite's price holds no value. The watch item: Indiana's quarterback picture is unsettled after Josh Hoover left the October 31 game with arm trouble. No true edge, but the lean is Indiana -9: the home favorite with the better record, and the points are the only way to play it.
games.title: USC at Indiana: the Big Ten showcase
games.verdict: LEAN: IND -9.0 — no true edge; the moneyline holds no value, so take the points with the home favorite.
games.weather: Cold and dry in Bloomington; no NWS watch or warning.

games.take: No. 16 Oregon (6-3) hosts Michigan (5-4) at Autzen, and the Ducks are coming in hot — they erased a 14-0 deficit to beat Ohio State 41-28. Our fair number makes Oregon a 77.8% favorite in a low 40.0-total game, but no price clears our 0.75% bar; both sides price at about -2.3% EV. No true edge, but the lean is Oregon -10: the hotter team at home in a game the market expects to stay low-scoring, where the favorite's defense should control it.
games.title: Michigan at Oregon: the Ducks defend Autzen
games.verdict: LEAN: ORE -10.0 — no true edge; both sides price the same, so take the hotter home favorite.

games.take: This one carries a real edge — it is on our board. Kentucky -3 at +104 is +3.0% EV against devigged Pinnacle. No. 13 Kentucky (7-2) is protecting its playoff standing at home, and Florida (5-4) has scored two touchdowns in its last two games while cycling through quarterbacks — Aaron Philo returns as the starter after being benched twice, and the Gators are without their top receiver. Kentucky leads the SEC in turnover margin at +10, and its defense is second in the conference in interceptions. The lean is Kentucky -3, and unlike most of today's card, this one clears our bar.
games.title: Florida at Kentucky: the board's SEC edge
games.verdict: LEAN: UK -3.0 — a real edge (+3.0% EV on the board); the steadier team at home against a quarterback carousel.
games.weather: Coldest game of Florida's season, 30-40F at kickoff; dry, no NWS watch or warning.

games.take: The night game: No. 6 Texas (7-2) goes to No. 21 LSU (6-3) in Death Valley, and it is loser-goes-home for playoff hopes on both sides. Our fair number makes LSU a 65% favorite, but no price clears our 0.75% bar — the least-bad number is LSU on the moneyline at -194 (-1.5% EV). No true edge, but the lean is LSU -4.5: the home favorite at night in Tiger Stadium, in a game the market expects to stay under 46.
games.title: Texas at LSU: loser goes home
games.verdict: LEAN: LSU -4.5 — no true edge; the least-bad price is the home favorite at night in Death Valley.

games.take: This one carries a real edge — it is on our board. South Carolina / Arkansas Over 51.5 at -105 is +1.8% EV against devigged Pinnacle. No. 17 South Carolina (6-3) has won five straight and averages 34.7 points and 452.6 yards a game; Arkansas (3-6) allows well over 300 yards a game and nearly beat Auburn last week. The headwinds are real and stated on the board: QB LaNorris Sellers is questionable with an ankle injury, and the Gamecocks are without their leading rusher and three offensive linemen. The lean is Over 51.5, and it clears our bar.
games.title: South Carolina at Arkansas: the board's total
games.venue: Donald W. Reynolds Razorback Stadium, Fayetteville, AR
games.verdict: LEAN: Over 51.5 — a real edge (+1.8% EV on the board); the Gamecocks' offense against a leaky Arkansas defense.
games.weather: Sunny, 41F at kickoff, 0% rain, light wind. No NWS watch or warning.

games.take: Denver is an 84.3% favorite on our fair number and laying 12 on the road; New Orleans (4-7) just got run off the floor 138-87 by Golden State. No price clears our 0.75% bar — the least-bad number is actually the Pelicans' moneyline at +530 (-1.1% EV), which tells you how little value the favorite's price holds. No true edge, but the lean is New Orleans +12: at home, getting a dozen against a favorite whose price has no value in it. Our Saddiq Bey Under 2.5 threes prop lives in this game.
games.title: Nuggets at Pelicans: the big number
games.venue: Smoothie King Center, New Orleans, LA
games.verdict: LEAN: NOP +12.0 — no true edge; the least-bad price is the home dog, so take the points.
